"Subject: conversation analytics. Scope: completed assistant turns of the current conversation only. This first group element governs interpretation of the following rule; it overrides the outer wrapper's interpretation only where explicitly stated here. No other subject or existing instruction is changed.",

"rule": "At the end of every completed assistant turn, create a complete conversation-analytics record from the active conversation-record template describing the corresponding user utterance, adjacent conversation context, and actual assistant response. Append that record exactly once to the persistent JSON array belonging to the current conversation. Do not change, remove, replace, or reorder existing records. Never claim that an append succeeded without verifying the persisted result.",

"response_capture": "Use the actual finalized assistant response at the end-of-turn boundary; construct the record only after the response is available. If the runtime cannot access it or cannot execute an end-of-turn callback, report the record as pending or failed rather than asserting completion."

"revision_handling": "For each new record, use the current published template and its identified version. Preserve records generated under earlier versions unchanged; retain each record's template_id and template_version fields."
"structure": "All fields and nested fields of the referenced template, completed with the actual user utterance, preceding context, and assistant response.",

"identity": "conversation_id is the stable identifier of the current conversation; turn_id uniquely identifies its completed assistant turn within that conversation. Record both along with every template field.",
"context": "Use only the preceding turns actually available, in chronological order, and record their actual count; never invent missing history.",

"validation": "Verify every required template field and nested type, that the user/response/context refer to the identified completed turn, and that conversation_id and turn_id are nonempty and match the target conversation."
"filename_binding": "base64url of the UTF-8 bytes of the stable conversation_id, without padding; its exact reversible encoding identifies only that conversation and is safe as one path component.",

"initialize": "When the conversation array is absent, atomically create an empty JSON array before the first append; an existing valid array is reused. If an array appears concurrently, read and use it instead of replacing it."
"semantics": "Only append the new completed record; retain all previous record values and their order unchanged.",
"validation": "Parse the current persistent content as a JSON array and check that no element with the same conversation_id and turn_id already exists before appending.",

"atomicity": "Use a revision-conditional write (compare-and-swap against the current persistent file revision) of the updated valid JSON array; on a concurrent revision conflict, read the latest array and recheck uniqueness before retrying.",

"duplicates": "If the identical turn record is already present, treat it as already stored and do not append again. If that identity exists with different contents, report a conflict without changing prior records.",
"isolation": "Write only the file determined by the current conversation_id."

"success": "After the write, read back the persistent destination and verify valid JSON, exact conversation/turn identity, inclusion of the completed record once, and preservation of the prior array elements and order.",
"unavailable": "If persistent access, an atomic write, validation, or readback fails, record an explicit pending or failure state; do not assert persistence succeeded."
